name: Maximal number of unit circles through n points in plane, each circle containing 3 of the points.
reference: Paul Erdős and George Purdy, Extremal problems in combinatorial geometry, Chapter 17 in Handbook of Combinatorics, North-Holland '95, p. 848. [Incorrectly says (on p. 847) that each circle must contain a pair of the points.]
link: Erdős problems database contributors, Erdős problem database, see no. 104.
Heiko Harborth and Ingrid Mengersen, Point sets with many unit circles, Discrete Mathematics 60 (1986) 193-197.
Heiko Harborth, Einheitskreise in ebenen Punktmengen, 3. Kolloquium über Diskrete Geometrie, Institut für Mathematik der Universität Salzburg, May 1985, pp. 163-168. [Establishes a(8) = 16.]
author: _N. J. A. Sloane_
